title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and representative runners (v33)
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds v33 of benchmark-lab profiling baselines and representative workload runners: new runners for chat/generation, streaming, embeddings and batched inference; cold/warm start and KV-cache profiling baselines; reporting pipeline wiring and postsubmit sampling. No breaking changes.
description: Context: expand representative coverage and improve automated profiling for production inference workloads. This PR adds a set of representative workload runners (chat_stream_runner, generation_batched_runner, embeddings_batch_runner, kv_cache_stress_runner), profiling baselines for cold/warm starts and KV-cache heavy scenarios, and integrates results into the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline so we can track regressions over time. Motivation: recent regressions in latency/cold-start regressions surfaced by manual runs; adding automated baselines and representative runners will let us catch regressions earlier and correlate changes to runtime/kernel selection. What changed: added new runner implementations under benchmark-lab/runners/representative/, added profiling harness and baselines under benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/, extended the reporting pipeline to ingest the new baseline payloads and upload to staging S3, added a lightweight postsubmit job ci/benchmark-lab-postsubmit.yml that runs a sampled subset of runners to avoid blowing CI budget, updated docs/docs/benchmark-lab.md with usage and how to add new runners, and added a feature flag BENCHLAB_HEAVY_RUNNERS to gate expensive runs. Testing: local profiling runs on internal staging cluster (8xA100-80GB) for generation and kv_cache scenarios, validated metrics ingestion via staging reporting, ran CI (unit/integration) where one perf integration flaked and was retried. Rollout notes: merged to main; postsubmit will backfill last 30 days of baselines in reporting; heavy runners are opt-in behind feature flag. Checklist: - [x] add representative runners - [x] add profiling harness and baselines - [x] wire reporting pipeline - [x] add CI postsubmit job - [x] update docs - [x] add basic unit/integration tests Related: ENG-8343, ENG-8410.

notes: This PR intentionally gates expensive runners behind a feature flag to avoid unexpected load on shared infra. Team should monitor postsubmit costs for the first week after merge and adjust sampling percentage as needed.
